item.title: Anonymous donor pays $8k debt for senior after 13 Investigates reported state's SNAP error
item.description: After 13 Investigates reported about an 84-year-old who owes the state nearly $9,000 due to an error by the SNAP office, an anonymous donor paid her bill in full.

item.title: Police investigating series of break-ins at Bellaire gym for kids with special needs
item.description: Bellaire police are investigating after a series of break-ins at a gym for kids with special needs.

item.title: $1.25 million settlement for family of teen with special needs killed in Harris Co. jail: Attorney
item.description: The family of Fred Harris, a 19-year-old with intellectual disabilities murdered by a cellmate in the Harris County jail in 2021, has reached a settlement with the county for $1.25 million.

item.title: Lawson Legacy lives on at ABC13 and across city of Houston
item.description: The deeply-rooted Lawson family legacy lives on at ABC13 and across the city of Houston.

item.title: 20-year-old plaintiff testifies she became addicted to social media as early as 6 in landmark trial
item.description: The woman - identified in court as KGM - is the key plaintiff in the case, which alleges she began using social media as young as age 6 and became dependent on the apps.

item.title: Man and woman killed in high-speed wreck in east Houston, HPD says
item.description: A man and a woman were killed in an accident where Houston police says a driver that was driving too fast likely lost control.

item.title: Stark statistic: 68% of 3rd graders don't read at grade level, highlighting literacy crisis
item.description: Literacy Now is once again hosting its annual Houston Reads Day and is looking for volunteers to take just 20 minutes out of the day to share a book with local students at more than 40 schools.

item.title: Instagram says it will notify parents if teens 'repeatedly' search for terms related to suicide
item.description: Instagram said Thursday it will start alerting parents if their kids repeatedly search for terms clearly associated with suicide or self-harm.

item.title: HISD moves forward with plan to close 12 campuses after lengthy and tense public meeting
item.description: In a meeting on Thursday, HISD's Board of Managers decided to close the campuses in a 9-0 vote.

item.title: Warner Bros. Discovery deems Paramount's takeover bid superior to Netflix deal
item.description: Netflix is declining to raise its offer to buy Warner Bros. Discovery's studio and streaming business.
